verdict.rationale: Gemini CLI is itself a natural-language agent. Its README documents querying and editing codebases, debugging with natural language, and plain-English prompts such as "@github List my open pull requests". A hands-on user reports it navigating very large codebases effectively. Community reports of agentic loops and failed edits concern how reliably tasks get executed, not whether natural-language operation exists, so they lower quality rather than create a dispute. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of natural-language command handling beyond README bullets, and consistent independent evidence that natural-language tasks run reliably.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Debug issues and troubleshoot with natural language
I have thrown very large codebases at this and it has been able to navigate and learn them effortlessly.
